scope.runtimeDependencies: Direct implementation dependencies published as runtime dependencies and external to the runtime JAR.
scope.platformDependencies: Direct dependencies declared through Fabric Loom's minecraft configuration, tracked separately and external to the runtime JAR.
scope.testDependencies: Test-only dependencies are outside this runtime provenance record.

license.rationale: Neither this repository nor the authoritative Minecraft 26.1.2 metadata used by Fabric Loom states a license or redistribution grant for this platform artifact; no license is inferred.
evidence: Repository LICENSE and NOTICE cover FarmHelper and upstream attribution, not this external platform dependency.
Fabric Loom metadata mojang_minecraft_info.json and the resolved minecraft-common-deobf-26.1.2.pom contain no license field for this artifact.

redistribution.rationale: The Minecraft platform artifact remains external to the runtime JAR; the project JAR task embeds only the repository LICENSE and NOTICE.
evidence: build.gradle declares Minecraft through the minecraft configuration and adds only LICENSE and NOTICE to the runtime JAR.
